metadata.title: fix(auth): cache get_token_revocation / is_token_revoked to eliminate hot-path DB queries
metadata.author: msureshkumar88

description:
Closes #4526

## Summary

- `TokenCatalogService.is_token_revoked()` and `get_token_revocation()` hit the database unconditionally on every request; `auth_cache` was unused on the read path despite already being the source of truth for revocations.
- Added `set_not_revoked(jti)` to `auth_cache` to cache negative results with a TTL, guarded against overwriting confirmed revocations.
- Both service methods now check the cache first and fall back to DB only on a miss; they call `set_not_revoked()` to warm the cache after a DB non-revocation result.
- All paths fall through to DB on cache errors (fail-closed).

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `mcpgateway/cache/auth_cache.py` | Add `set_not_revoked(jti)` |
| `mcpgateway/services/token_catalog_service.py` | Cache-first logic in `is_token_revoked` and `get_token_revocation` |
| `tests/unit/mcpgateway/cache/test_auth_cache_l1_l2.py` | 4 new tests for `set_not_revoked` |
| `tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_token_catalog_service_cache.py` | 11 new tests covering cache-hit, cache-miss, and error-fallback paths |

commits.message:
fix(auth): cache get_token_revocation via auth_cache to eliminate hot-path DB queries

Wire auth_cache.is_token_revoked() into TokenCatalogService.is_token_revoked()
and get_token_revocation() so confirmed-revoked and confirmed-not-revoked tokens
skip the DB round-trip on repeat calls.

Add set_not_revoked() to AuthCache for negative result caching (TTL-bounded by
revocation_ttl, default 30 s). invalidate_revocation() already evicts these
entries atomically on revocation, so no token can bypass enforcement via a stale
False entry. Both service methods remain fail-closed: cache errors fall through
to the DB.

Closes #2692

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

commits.message:
test(auth): cover silenced set_not_revoked exception paths in token catalog service

Add two tests that raise from auth_cache.set_not_revoked() after a DB miss,
covering the bare except/pass branches at lines 941 and 1175 in
TokenCatalogService.is_token_revoked() and get_token_revocation().
